title: WATCH AGAIN: Joint press conference of the Latvian and Estonian Presidents
summary_full: On October 13, President Edgars Rinkēvičs will receive the new President of the Republic of Estonia, Dr. Ülle Madise, on a working visit to the Republic of Latvia.
summary_public: On October 13, President Edgars Rinkēvičs will receive the new President of the Republic of Estonia, Dr. Ülle Madise, on a working visit to the Republic of Latvia.
